# Second SVG gap pass — 28 October 2026

The pass reviewed all **114 remaining visual gaps**. It adds **14 unique SVG studies**, reaching **497 studies** across **584 research records**. **87 physical-record SVG slots remain open**. All 483 previously published SVG assets are preserved. This is a working research inventory, not a complete or authenticated catalogue raisonné.

| Outcome for an original slot | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| New SVG on retained original record | 14 |
| Joined to a newly illustrated physical identity | 1 |
| Joined to an already illustrated physical identity | 7 |
| Proven nonpainting; all evidence preserved | 5 |
| Original slot still lacking an SVG | 87 |

A merge can close several original slots with one image; original-slot counts and remaining physical-record counts therefore need not be equal. Merges and exclusions are not counted as newly drawn vectors.

The new vectors cover 9 confirmed paintings, 4 painting candidates and 1 provisional painting group. The remaining gaps comprise 27 confirmed paintings, 59 candidates and 1 painting group. The all-version blue filter includes 186 tagged records, 170 SVGs and 16 open visual slots. Some unillustrated color tags remain title-derived and nonexhaustive.

## What changed in the research

Three subagents revisited museum, market/publication, and Foundation references. The lead revisited SFMOMA and chronology leads. Fresh alternate public reproductions were checked against specific captions, collection records and prior references. Failed or inadequate references remain documented in the per-record outcomes.

Examples include the actual Rose Museum Blue White reproduction embedded in a primary gallery essay, museum and architect photographs of the Grand Rapids commission, and the color Ormesson illustration in a university thesis checked against the Foundation's historical installation. The Grand Rapids exhibition hero shows a different artist's painting and was explicitly rejected as a Kelly reference.

Painted white supports are kept. Walls, photo margins, frames, shadows and relief depth are omitted. Early paintings with subtle tonal layers receive explicitly schematic major-motif studies only where adequate; figurative portraits and unknown color placements remain gaps. A black-and-white photograph plus a colorful title does not establish the original pigment arrangement.

Observed projections, variable screen/installation arrangements and uncertain physical proportions remain excluded from true-scale viewing. Source measurements and conflicts survive; the SVG is not stretched to disguise a mismatch. Any partial installation view is explicitly qualified in its study notes.

## Validation and remaining limits

**44 automated checks pass; 0 fail.** Checks cover source-row preservation, identity uniqueness and canonical identifiers, parseable raster-free SVGs, gallery-compatible paths, inspected reference files, physical aspect ratios where eligible, and exclusion evidence. Source/vector comparison sheets support visual review, including a second agent's review of the lead's studies and the lead's independent review of the subagent batches.

The record-by-record ledger preserves every starting slot and its reviewed outcome. Historical dates, sizes, ownership credits and contradictory captions are kept as evidence. Confirmed paintings without adequate references stay visible alongside provisional candidates. Authenticated Bois catalogue inventories remain a separate reconciliation boundary. No claim of full catalogue coverage or copyright clearance follows from these interpretive SVGs.

The portable bundle contains metadata, code, ledgers and interpretive vectors. Original source photographs, scanned books and full OCR remain local research references and are excluded from distribution.

## Rebuild

Run the four `scripts/build_gap_*_studies_v6.py` generators, then `scripts/build_catalogue.py`, `scripts/validate_catalogue.py`, `scripts/audit_svg_gaps_v6.py` and this report generator. The prior v5 outcome ledger remains a historical audit. New identity resolutions apply after chronology slots exist, allowing those original placeholders to join a proven physical identity without losing their evidence.
